sourceEvidence.claim: Vitamin A includes retinal, retinol, retinoic acid
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.claim: Function: visual pigments, epithelial differentiation, prevents squamous metaplasia
sourceEvidence.quote: Antioxidant; constituent of visual pigments (retinal); essential for normal differentiation of epithelial cells into specialized tissue (pancreatic cells, mucus-secreting cells); prevents squamous metaplasia.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.claim: Bitot spots: keratin debris with foamy appearance on conjunctiva (photograph label A)
sourceEvidence.quote: conjunctival squamous metaplasia → Bitot spots (keratin debris; foamy appearance on conjunctiva A ); corneal degeneration (keratomalacia); immunosuppression.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.claim: Deficiency: nyctalopia, xerosis cutis, xerophthalmia, keratomalacia, immunosuppression
sourceEvidence.quote: Night blindness (nyctalopia); dry, scaly skin (xerosis cutis); dry eyes (xerophthalmia)
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.claim: Retinol is vitamin A — think retin-A for wrinkles and acne
sourceEvidence.quote: Retinol is vitamin A, so think retin-A (used topically for wrinkles and Acne).
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: Found in liver and leafy vegetables.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.claim: Vitamin A supplementation in measles may improve outcomes
sourceEvidence.quote: Supplementation in vitamin A-deficient measles patients may improve outcomes.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.claim: Isotretinoin for severe cystic acne; all-trans retinoic acid for APL
sourceEvidence.quote: Use oral isotretinoin to treat severe cystic acne. Use all-trans retinoic acid to treat acute promyelocytic leukemia.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.claim: Teratogenic via homeobox gene — ⊝ pregnancy test + two contraception forms required
sourceEvidence.quote: Teratogenic (interferes with homeobox gene; cleft palate, cardiac abnormalities), therefore a ⊝ pregnancy test and two forms of contraception are required before isotretinoin (vitamin A derivative) is prescribed.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: Acute toxicity—nausea, vomiting, ↑ ICP (eg, vertigo, blurred vision).
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.claim: Chronic toxicity: alopecia, dry skin, hepatotoxicity, arthralgias, IIH
sourceEvidence.quote: Chronic toxicity—alopecia, dry skin (eg, scaliness), hepatic toxicity and enlargement, arthralgias, and idiopathic intracranial hypertension.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)
